Sub: Declaration of Result - Recruitment for the Post of Assistant Professor_Contractual
The interviews for the post of Assistant Professor (contractual) in below given subjects were conducted on
25th and 26th June, 2026. The Board of Management, in its meeting held on 29th June, 2026, vide item
no.12.11 has approved the Minutes of the Selection Committees.
Accordingly, the following candidates have been selected for appointment to the post of Assistant
Professor for a period of eleven month contractual period from the date of joining subject to verification of
original documents, and other terms and conditions prescribed by the University.
SN Name of Post with subject Name of Selected Candidate
1 Assistant Professor-English BAKHALAKIYA SANJANABEN H.
2 Assistant Professor-Gujarati VALA KISHORKUMAR N.
3 Assistant Professor-Gujarati MAKAVANA KOMALBEN R.
4 Assistant Professor-Gujarati JOGAL DILIPBHAI K.
5 Assistant Professor-Chemistry (Organic) MORABIYA JITUBHAI H.
6 Assistant Professor- Sanskrit KELAIYA MAULIK J.
7 Assistant Professor- Sanskrit JADAV AJAYKUMAR J.
8 Assistant Professor- Sanskrit PAMAK SHARDA K.
9 Assistant Professor- History PARMAR PARESH GIGABHAI
10 Assistant Professor- History VAGHELA VIMAL RAJA
11 Assistant Professor- Environmental
Sciences GOSWAMI MOHITGIRI A.
12 Assistant Professor- Environmental
Sciences PARMAR ABHAY S.
The following candidates have been placed on the waiting list. The waiting list shall be operated
only if any selected candidate fails to join or declines the offer of appointment.
SN Name of Post with subject Name of Candidate placed in the
waiting list
1 Assistant Professor-English DANGAR RAJESHBHAI
PANCHABHAI
2 Assistant Professor-Gujarati BATHIYA ANAND M.
3 Assistant Professor-Gujarati HIRAPARA GAYATRIBEN S.
4 Assistant Professor-Chemistry (Organic) MUSHKAN R.
5 Assistant Professor- Sanskrit MAKVANA RAMILA R.
6 Assistant Professor- Sanskrit MAHETA AJAYKUMAR H.
7 Assistant Professor- History VAGHELA ROHITBHAI
KHIMABHAI
8 Assistant Professor- History MAKAWANA KEVALKUMAR R.
9 Assistant Professor- Environmental
Sciences SINGHAL TANYA K.
Appointment letters will be emailed to the selected candidates soon. After getting letter, the selected candidate
should have to join the concerned department within the time period mentioned in the appointment letter.
Chairman, Recruitment Cell
